title: Additive constant-presheaf charts near each point of a finite set chart
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $G$ an abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], $U$ an object of its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], $S$ a finite set in the next universe, and $e$ an isomorphism from the restriction to $U$ of the underlying set sheaf of $G$ to the constant sheaf with value $S$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For each underlying point $x$ of $U$, there exist an etale $V\to U$, a point $v$ of $V$ above $x$, a finite abelian group $M$, a set-sheaf isomorphism $e\prime:\underline{|M|}\to |G|_V$ on the localized small etale site at $V\to Y$, and a natural transformation of abelian presheaves $\alpha:\operatorname{const}(M)\to G_V$. After forgetting abelian structure, $\alpha$ equals the constant set presheaf sheafification unit [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] followed by the underlying presheaf map of $e\prime$. No nonemptiness or connectedness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Fix an underlying point x of U.left and choose a geometric point above it. Identify the localized small etale site at U with the small etale site of its domain. For each geometric point of that domain, the stalk of the given constant set sheaf is S: sheafification preserves stalks, and the cofiltered pointed-neighborhood category has connected opposite, whose constant-diagram colimit is S. The set chart therefore transports the abelian stalk operations to S.

The chart supplies constant sections indexed by S. For every pair of labels compare their sum in G with the section labeled by their sum in the transported stalk group. Compare zero and all negatives likewise. The germs agree. Equality of germs is equality on some pointed neighborhood by Mathlib Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff′. There are finitely many comparisons because S and S times S are finite. Cofilteredness gives a single pointed refinement on which all comparisons hold.

Restrict the label sections to the common pointed neighborhood V. Their zero and addition identities define additive maps M to the sections of G on every object of the localized site at V; restriction compatibility defines a natural transformation α from the constant abelian presheaf. Transport the restricted original set chart along the bijection between the finite abelian group M and S to obtain e′. On underlying presheaves, α is precisely the constant set sheafification unit followed by e′. The geometric lift supplies v in V.left with V.hom(v)=x. This stops before sheafifying α or assembling a covering.
